'''Teshenawa''' (Teshenanchi) is an extinct [[Afro-Asiatic languages|Afro-Asiatic]] language formerly spoken in Teshena town of [[Kafin Hausa]] LGA, [[Jigawa State]], [[Nigeria]].<ref name=e13>{{Ethnologue13|twc|Teshenawa}}</ref><ref name="BlenchAtlas4">{{Cite book|title=An Atlas of Nigerian Languages|last=Blench|first=Roger|publisher=Kay Williamson Educational Foundation|year=2019|edition=4th|location=Cambridge}}</ref> It was closely related to the also-extinct [[Auyokawa language|Auyokawa]] and still-living [[Bade language|Bade]].<ref name=":0" />
